metricDefinitions.label: Core relevance

methods.code: score = inputRelevance*6 + aiInput*4 + breakthrough*4 + potential*3 + wonder*2 + heat; core = inputRelevance >= 4 || aiInput >= 4; frontier = isHardware && breakthrough >= 4 && wonder >= 4; selectionPath = core && frontier ?
